messages:
morgan: Heads-up — planning a quiet v2 cutover tonight 23:00 UTC. Low-traffic window, goal is default route flip v1->v2 with immediate fallback to v1 for 15m. Please post client pins now if you need holdouts.

deploybot: scheduled deploy created: id=deploy-17675, window=2025-02-12T23:00:00Z->2025-02-13T00:00:00Z, canary=10%, rollforward=manual. @morgan confirm to start.

sasha: quick question — are we changing header semantics? mobile clients still on legacy header casing. If so we need a soft-flag or shim.

morgan: No semantic changes to responses. Just default route change. But header casefolding will be enabled in the proxy layer for v2 to reduce client breakage. That should cover mobile.

lee: Add rollback criteria: if total 5xx rate > 1.5% OR delta in p95 latency > +200ms sustained for 5m => rollback. Also if mobile error rate >2% in first 10m.

sam: +1 to those gates. Can we also watch auth failures (401 spikes)? Last time a client SDK had a bug and auth spiked.

jia: ops checklist posted to #release-playbooks. Pin command for operators if needed:
```
# pin route for a tenant (operator)
deploybot pin-route --route "/api" --version v1 --tenant=tenant-123 --duration 2h
```

morgan: Thanks @jia. I'll add a small canary probe set for mobile-heavy tenants and a shadow traffic pass for the first 5m.

sasha: Release notes: changed default routing for /api. Callout for SDKs: please respect X-Api-Version header. Docs PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/842 — needs one more ack.

deploybot: deploy-17675: canary start queued at 2025-02-12T23:00:00Z. Ops, runbook link: https://runbooks/redwood/v2-cutover. I will post health pings into this thread during rollout.

lee: Operator checklist:
- eyes on p95/latency, 5xx, auth spike
- check client signals: header count, version header present
- if rollback, run `deploybot rollback deploy-17675 --reason "telemetry"` and notify #incidents

morgan: A few pinned tenants requested holdout — @deploybot pinned them (tenant-77, tenant-424). If anyone else needs pinning shout now.

sasha: :thumbsup: Docs PR merged. I added a short note about header casefolding and SDK patch note.

sam: During canary please watch region eu-west-1 — last rollout had a shard hiccup there. If error floor >0.5% for 3m, escalate to infra.

deploybot: canary started. pinging health metrics...

deploybot: metric snapshot (t+3m): overall 5xx=0.12%, p95 latency +18ms, mobile errors 0.3%, auth failures stable.

lee: looks good so far. Proceed to ramp to 50% at operator discretion.

morgan: Ramp to 50% now. Will monitor next 10m then full flip if green.

deploybot: ramped to 50%. continuing to stream health.

deploybot: metric snapshot (t+9m): overall 5xx=0.18%, p95 +22ms, mobile errors 0.4%, auth 0.03%. All under thresholds.

sasha: Preparing release note final blurb. Morgan, anything to add on rollback messaging to customers?

morgan: No customer-facing rollback planned; any rollbacks are internal fallback to v1. We'll notify only if we hit public degradations.

deploybot: ramp complete: default route switched to v2. will keep v1 warm for 15m before full retire.

sam: Monitoring for 15m window. If anything weird, call timeout and rollback.

lee: marking this thread as watchable by ops rota. Good job team. :tada:
